detail: Named Politician of the Year in the context of the Swiss Award show, recognising her public profile as a St. Gallen cantonal councillor.
Made an honorary citizen of the city of Wil, where she grew up, following her election to the Federal Council.

honor: One of the 25 most influential women of 2023
detail: Listed by the Financial Times among the most influential women worldwide, primarily credited for her engagement with the acquisition of Credit Suisse by UBS.
